Sub-phase 4a is complete. Here's what was created:

### Files created (3):

1. **`src/modules/leave-request/leave-request.model.ts`** — Exports:
   - `LeaveRequest` interface with all 14 fields: `id`, `employeeId`, `leavePolicyId`, `startDate`, `endDate`, `reason` (string | undefined), `status` (LeaveStatus), `approvedBy` (string | null), `approvedAt` (Date | null), `cancelledBy` (string | null), `cancelledAt` (Date | null), `createdAt`, `updatedAt`
   - `CreateLeaveRequestDto`: `{ employeeId, leavePolicyId, startDate, endDate, reason? }`
   - `UpdateLeaveRequestDto`: `Partial<{ startDate, endDate, reason, status }>`
   - `LeaveRequestQueryParams`: `{ employeeId?, status?, leavePolicyId?, startDate?, endDate? }`
   - Imports `LeaveStatus` from `shared/types` (public entry point)

2. **`src/modules/leave-request/leave-request.repository.ts`** — Exports:
   - `ILeaveRequestRepository` extending `IBaseRepository<LeaveRequest>` with: `findByEmployeeId`, `findByStatus`, `findOverlapping`, `findByDateRange`, `findPendingForManager`
   - `LeaveRequestRepository` extending `BaseRepository<LeaveRequest>`, table `leave_requests`
   - `findOverlapping` uses the binding inclusive-day formula: `existing.startDate <= newEndDate AND existing.endDate >= newStartDate`, excludes REJECTED/CANCELLED statuses
   - `findPendingForManager` joins `employees` table on `manager_id` to find SUBMITTED requests for subordinates

3. **`src/modules/leave-request/index.ts`** — Barrel re-export of all public symbols from model and repository

- `tsc --noEmit` (build): ✅ passes with zero errors
- `jest --passWithNoTests`: ✅ all 58 existing tests pass
- All project constraints satisfied (no `any`, repository pattern, no hardcoded secrets, no `@gestalt/*` deps, imports via public entry points only)
